description: Schedule a post to the user's connected social accounts (youtube, tiktok, instagram, x, linkedin, linkedin_page, threads, bluesky, facebook). Every post follows ClipSpeed's posting rules, the same for every kind of post: at most 4 posts a day per platform (2 on LinkedIn and LinkedIn Pages), spaced 1–4 h apart by platform (list_channels gives each one's numbers), and the same words or file never go to one account twice within 30 days — a refusal says why and gives the next open time. Content is one of: clip_id (a finished ClipSpeed clip, from get_clip_status), text (a text post — X and LinkedIn), media_url (a public https image or video link; text is its caption), or media_urls (a carousel). media_urls (2 or more public https image/video links, in order) makes ONE carousel post: Instagram up to 10 (images and videos), Threads up to 20 (images and videos), Facebook Page up to 10 images, X and Bluesky up to 4 images, TikTok up to 32 images (a photo post), LinkedIn up to 20 images (sent as a swipeable PDF document); YouTube and Pinterest take one file, and a platform that cannot take the set is refused at booking, never cut. A picked scheduled_at is booked exactly or refused with the next open time; omit it to post as soon as possible. preview: true books nothing and returns the plan. Returns, per platform, the scheduled time in the user's time zone and the post id, or why it was not scheduled. post_type 'story' posts an Instagram or Facebook Page story instead (no caption; media_urls become separate stories in order, up to 10).

clip_id.description: A finished clip to publish (from get_clip_status).

media_url.description: Public https link to an image or video to post.

media_urls.description: A carousel: 2 or more public https image/video links, in order. Use instead of media_url.

per_platform.description: Optional per-channel copy: override text, title or hashtags for one platform, e.g. { "x": { "text": "short version" } }. Keys must be in platforms; a field left out uses the shared one. Each platform is checked against its own limit.

platforms.description: Platforms to publish to (each must be connected — list_channels). linkedin_page = a LinkedIn company Page; facebook = a Facebook Page.

post_type.description: 'feed' (default) or 'story' (Instagram, Facebook Page; no caption; media_urls = stories in order).

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 time to publish. Omit to publish as soon as possible.

text.description: Post text / caption (required for a text post).

title.description: Post title where the platform has one (YouTube requires it).

name: schedule_post
